killedBy: spawnBullet + ownerShellCount honours a tank's own shellCap over the roster's, and only when one is stamped (issue #358)
why: Reads the roster's cap and ignores the tank's own, so issue #358's role-first arm stamps a number nothing consumes -- the flag changes a value and not the game, which is the failure mode a menu-label feature has. Shipped behaviour is unaffected either way (no tank carries a cap without the flag), so only a fixture that stamps one can tell the difference, which is why the scoped test builds one below the roster cap and asserts the refusal fires there.
